'''Kym''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Along with [[Renthor]] and [[Ulbert]], Kym was a former student of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] who was not quite sane and had corrupted the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. Despite having no aptitude for [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Kym and his fellows took their teacher's creed to heart. Unfortunately, the corruption of Jedi Code caused them to believe that mechanical devices had to be destroyed.<ref name="FC" />
